faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CAU recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application form to the Office of the Dean, College of Horticulture & Forestry, CAU (I), Pasighat is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for this recruitment drive, specifically for the posts of Project Associate-I and Technical Assistant/Field Assistant-I.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates must send their filled application form along with self-attested documents by hand or by post to the specified address in Arunachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for these posts. Candidates can apply without paying any charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation for reserved categories is provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Technical Assistant/Field Assistant-I post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q7. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 October 2026, starting from 10:00 AM at the Conference Hall, College of Horticulture & Forestry, CAU (I), Pasighat.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project, which runs up to 31 March 2031. Initial engagement is for one year.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry self-attested photocopies of all educational and experience certificates, along with the original documents for verification at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply if I am currently employed?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates currently employed must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer to be eligible for the selection process.
